criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 17 April 2027 (12 months after the 17 April 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 17 April 2027 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 17 April 2029 (36 months after Closing).
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.3 is stated as $31,250,000 but 25% of the $100,000,000 Purchase Price is $25,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (17 April 2027), with days remaining from 24 March 2026 (389 days).
Notes that 17 April 2027 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 19 April 2027.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
